title: Prompt log entry
description: Front matter for a raw markdown prompt log in packages/2nd-brain/content/. One file per agent session.

event.description: Short title for what the session did.

outcome.description: What shipped or was learned. Include commit SHAs where relevant.

prompt_excerpt.description: First words of the operator prompt, verbatim. No secrets.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Modeled LLM spend for the session, mid-tier rates.

tags.description: Free-form tags. See TAG_RULES in the owner-brain builder.

blog_slug.description: Slug of the rendered post in apps/main-site/blog/, if this log became an article.
